 ✈ RAWRTrip ⌘ Tech Jungle ▥ BizNest ▣ RAWRMag ♛ RAWR Awards ★ Reviews Home › Press Release › ShopeeVIP+ Adds YouTube Premium Lite in Indonesia, Thailand and the Philippines Press Release ShopeeVIP+ Adds YouTube Premium Lite in Indonesia, Thailand and the Philippines
 ♛ By Lion's Den • November 18, 2026 • 4 min read Share this story f 𝕏 ↗ @ 
 Following the momentum of ShopeeVIP+, Shopee has announced its newest addition to the “Shopping meets Streaming with One subscription, more ways to stream!” offering: YouTube Premium Lite. Starting 11 November, ShopeeVIP+ subscribers in Indonesia, Thailand and the Philippines will have access to both YouTube Premium Lite and Netflix, with no additional fee beyond the ShopeeVIP+ subscription fee.
 With YouTube Premium Lite, ShopeeVIP+ subscribers can:
 Watch their favourite videos with fewer ads
Download most videos to watch later, even without mobile data or Wi-Fi.
Keep most videos playing in the background while using other apps or when the screen is locked
 Existing ShopeeVIP+ members can activate YouTube Premium Lite in the Shopee app or through the activation link sent via e-mail or SMS from 11 November at no additional cost.
 This latest addition strengthens the value of ShopeeVIP+ for Filipinos. Beyond the products they buy, consumers also consider convenience, delivery savings, and value for money when shopping online – and ShopeeVIP+ is designed around these needs. With YouTube Premium Lite joining Netflix access, free shipping on every order, and an exclusive 20% discount voucher every day, ShopeeVIP+ brings shopping, savings and entertainment together in one subscription.
 Jack Ng, Head of Commercial at Shopee Philippines, said, “At Shopee, our goal is for ShopeeVIP+ to bring greater value and convenience to more parts of Filipinos’ everyday lives. Adding YouTube Premium Lite advances that goal by giving subscribers fewer ads and greater flexibility to enjoy content throughout the day. This partnership reflects our commitment to growing the program by adding benefits that matter to how Filipinos shop, watch, and unwind.”
 Upgraded Perks in One ShopeeVIP+ Subscription Bundle
 One ShopeeVIP+ subscription brings together shopping benefits, Netflix and YouTube Premium Lite at no additional cost. This offers a more convenient and affordable way to enjoy both services than subscribing to them separately. ShopeeVIP+ subscription benefits include:
 YouTube Premium Lite Access: Enjoy YouTube with fewer ads, offline downloads and background play.
Netflix Access: Enjoy your favourite series and films on Netflix, the world’s leading entertainment service, and watch top Filipino shows such as Ganito, Ganyan, Ganoon, 18th Rose, Call Me Mother, Someone, Someday and The Master Cutter.
Free Shipping Vouchers With No Minimum Spend: Subscribers can enjoy free shipping vouchers on every order with no minimum spend for a more convenient and cost-effective shopping experience.
Exclusive 20% Discount Every Day: Enjoy a 20% discount voucher every day.
Priority Customer Service: Get access to 24/7 priority customer service.
Choosing Your ShopeeVIP+ Plan
 The ShopeeVIP+ plan starts from PHP140 / month for a multi-month subscription plan, and PHP169 / month for a single-month subscription plan. ShopeeVIP+ is available in flexible plans so users can choose what suits their needs best.
 ShopeeVIP+ benefits, including YouTube Premium Lite and Netflix, can be enjoyed through a simple subscription process in the Shopee app:
 Open the Shopee app on your device.
On the homepage, select the ShopeeVIP icon.
Select the ShopeeVIP+ subscription package.
Make sure you have selected your preferred plan.
Tap “Subscribe” and select your preferred subscription period.
Complete the payment using one of the available payment methods.
Once successful, you will receive a notification confirming that you are officially a ShopeeVIP+ member.
Activate your YouTube Premium Lite benefit in-app or via an activation link sent through email or SMS.
 Existing ShopeeVIP+ subscribers can activate their YouTube Premium Lite benefit in the Shopee app following Step 8 above.
 During the Shopee 11.11 Big Sale, ShopeeVIP+ subscribers can experience even more exciting promotions. This includes Shopee VIP’s 11.11 Shake with a chance to win up to 1,111 coins.
 Join ShopeeVIP+ and enjoy multiple lifestyle benefits in one subscription. For more information, visit https://shopee.ph/vip-plus. Download the Shopee app for free from the App Store or Google Play.
